The BARBOUR JACKET! The Best Waxed Jacket! Now I own one, what a little lovely thing to have. 

Ah yes, the Barbour jacket, quite possibly the best waxed jacket to ever exist. Some may even say the best fall jacket to have. Or maybe even the best rain jacket to have? When buying one you'll be faced with a TON of heavy hitting questions, how waterproof is a waxed cotton Barbour? What is the difference between sylkoil and thornproof wax? Should I get the Bedale? The Ashby? The Beaufort? Should I get the Barbour hood? How should it fit? What is a tartan lining? How do I re-wax a Barbour jacket? Why are they so expensive?! WELL I go over most of those things and eventually I'll be going over re-waxing a Barbour jacket...provided I wear this one down quite a bit first. 

ANYWAYS
